newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Fin'l extends debt purchase offer.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Fin'l extends debt purchase offer.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Tuesday it extended its offer to purchase all of its outstanding 13 percent senior notes due 2000 and the related consent solicitation to 1700 EST March 6.
The old expiration was at midnight EST February 18.
Olympic, a consumer finance company, said terms of the offer to purchase and the consent solicitation are unchanged.
To date, senior notes aggregating about $10.7 million in principal amount have been deposited in the offer file and have provided consents in the solicitation.
